entity.title: Policy resolution
entity.description: How the action finds, loads and trusts the policy that governs a pull request.

rules.body: The action MUST read the policy file from the base branch of the pull request, never from its head, so that a pull request cannot change the policy that decides it.
The action MUST resolve an extends reference only when it names a tag or a full commit SHA, and MUST refuse a reference to a branch.
The action MUST refuse a policy whose extends chain contains a cycle or is deeper than the documented limit.
The action MUST refuse a policy file that does not validate against the published policy schema, and MUST then take no action on the pull request.
Each policy MUST cite at least one rule identifier of the referenced realm, and every review and log line the action writes for a decision MUST quote the cited identifiers.

The action MUST apply the first policy, in file order after extends are merged, whose match conditions the pull request satisfies, and on a pull request no policy matches MUST take no action beyond withdrawing an approval of its own.
